notes.title: Demo Update (1.0.1) - Features and Fixes
notes.notes:
Have you taken over the maps in the Demo yet? It's best with a friend to outsmart...

Development continues on full game features, but also support for the Demo to continue refining and updated.


New Feature: Guide (v1)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/a45bd047231b08b59af06e23986c822315158aab.png"]

This new guide will be expanded upon to address the depth of strategy for new players. I'm dedicated to making onboarding as robust as I can, so expect further guide categories and settings options!


Demo v 1.0.1


ːsteamthisː New Feature: Guide (above) has been added across all menus

ːsteamthisː New Feature: Additional sounds 

ːsteamthisː Offline mode: Supports saved Steam name (ie. on Deck without wifi)

ːsteamthisː Feature Update: Exhausted tiles are more easily restored, and in all shape configurations

ːsteamthisː Feature Update: Colonies preview tool has overhauled visibility and easier deactivation



Adjustments:

Tutorial: Stronger flow to teaching special tiles

Tutorial: UI/General improvements

Map shapes, including number of tiles, and amounts of special tiles improved

Clarification for Advanced Bloom build requirements

Bugs:

Users were able to lock themselves out of expansion in Tutorial

Exhausted event on previous system interfered with goal completion

Several UI bugs (pop-ups)


During release testing, I really enjoyed how broken up this Bisected map became.  It was quiet maze-like, and filled quickly with two CPU's taking over. BubbleFins of all sizes were on display.


You can note the tooltip as I hove the Climate: Hydrated state causing an energy boom.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000437/8316795706ca4fdb2ee4be5356fad9ded6362945.png"]Stay tuned, and as always I'm listening via Discord or in-game Feedback Surveys.  Love the feedback thus far, and keep up that real world fungi interest. There is so much to discover.



- Jake (SporeBloom Creator)
